records.source: I'm still getting things set up. Why don't you check back later?
records.translation: 我還在準備。晚點再來看看吧？

records.source: Hey there, @. Welcome to the Adventurer's Guild Challenge Booth.#$b#Every day, we'll have a pair of challenges for you to choose from. Complete one, and the guild will reward you with a bounty of Calico Eggs.#$b#Once you've selected a challenge, you won't be able to change your decision, so choose carefully!
records.translation: 嘿，@。歡迎來到冒險者公會挑戰攤位。#$b#每天我們都會提供兩項挑戰供你選擇。完成其中一項，公會就會獎勵你大量卡利科蛋。#$b#選定挑戰後就無法改變決定，所以要仔細挑選！

records.source: Looking to test your mettle, huh?#$b#I've got a few challenges that might do just that.
records.translation: 想考驗自己的勇氣，是吧？#$b#我這裡有幾項挑戰，正好能讓你如願。

records.source: Feeling the adventurer's spirit?#$b#Good, here are today's challenges.
records.translation: 感受到冒險者精神了嗎？#$b#很好，這些是今天的挑戰。

records.source: I hope you've kept your weapons maintained.#$b#You'll need them in top form for today's challenges.
records.translation: 希望你有好好保養武器。#$b#今天的挑戰需要它們保持最佳狀態。

records.source: I can see a bold look in your eye.#$b#How about a challenge?
records.translation: 我從你眼中看見了無畏的神情。#$b#來場挑戰如何？

records.source: Still working on the challenge, huh?#$b#Well, here it is, in case you needed a reminder.
records.translation: 還在進行挑戰，是吧？#$b#好吧，內容就在這裡，以免你需要提醒。

records.source: Very good.#$b#There'll be more challenges tomorrow, so take it easy and get some rest.
records.translation: 非常好。#$b#明天還有更多挑戰，所以放輕鬆，好好休息。

records.source: Hey, you did it! I'm impressed.#$b#That's it for this year, but Gil and I will be here again next time around.
records.translation: 嘿，你辦到了！真讓我刮目相看。#$b#今年就到這裡，但下次吉爾和我還會再來。

records.source: It's a brand new day... come back when you've proven yourself in the caverns.
records.translation: 新的一天才剛開始……等你在洞穴中證明自己後再來。

records.source: That's it for this year... *snore*...
records.translation: 今年就到這裡……*打呼*……

records.source: That's it for today. You can try again tomorrow, if you're up for it... *snore*...
records.translation: 今天就到這裡。如果還有精神，明天可以再試……*打呼*……

records.source: Submit today's highest egg rating to Gil?^(Egg Rating {0})
records.translation: 要將今天的最高蛋評分提交給吉爾嗎？^（蛋評分 {0}）

records.source: ...{0}? Hahahaha.... okay, kiddo. Here's a little prizey for you... now, go along and play with the other kids.
records.translation: ……{0}？哈哈哈哈……好吧，小鬼。這點小獎品給你……現在去和其他孩子玩吧。

records.source: ...{0}? That's not too impressive, but at least you had the gumption to try. Here's a little something.
records.translation: ……{0}？不算太亮眼，但至少你有膽量嘗試。這點東西給你。

records.source: {0}, huh? Not bad, not bad... of course, when I was your age I was doin' twice that. With a Rusty Sword, and no food!
records.translation: {0}，是吧？不錯，不錯……當然，我像你這麼大時，成績可是兩倍。手上只有一把生鏽的劍，而且沒帶食物！

records.source: {0}... that ain't bad at all. That's the kind of number we're looking for in the Adventurer's Guild. Here's your prize.
records.translation: {0}……這成績相當不錯。冒險者公會要找的就是這種數字。這是你的獎品。

records.source: {0}? Okay, now I'm impressed...#$b#Hey, Marlon! Get a load of this... an Egg Rating of {0} for the day!
records.translation: {0}？好吧，這下我真的佩服了……#$b#嘿，馬龍！快來看看……今天的蛋評分高達 {0}！

records.source: {0}!?!#$b#Well, I'll be... We've got a real Calico Egg hunter here!
records.translation: {0}！？！#$b#哎呀，真沒想到……這裡來了一位真正的卡利科蛋獵人！

records.source: You hear a voice in your head: 'It would be dishonorable to submit an egg rating acquired through the use of cheat code software!'
records.translation: 你的腦海中響起一個聲音：「提交透過作弊程式取得的蛋評分，是可恥的行為！」

records.source: Please return when an attendant is present.
records.translation: 請在工作人員到場後再來。

records.source: You're looking great!$h#$b#Come back another day and we'll put together a fresh new look for you!
records.translation: 你看起來棒極了！$h#$b#改天再來，我們會替你打造全新的造型！

records.source: Not half bad, sweetie!$h#$b#Come back soon, I'll have a new look waiting for you!
records.translation: 相當不錯，甜心！$h#$b#很快再來，我會準備好新造型等你！

records.source: Hmm, your backpack's looking a little full. Come back when you've made enough room for a full set of clothes!
records.translation: 嗯，你的背包好像有點滿了。騰出足夠空間放一整套衣服後再來！

records.source: Hmm, your backpack's looking a little full. Come back when you've made enough room for a full set of clothes.
records.translation: 嗯，你的背包好像有點滿了。騰出足夠空間放一整套衣服後再來。

records.source: Okay, before we continue, let me visualize your aura, to see what kind of style will make you happiest...
records.translation: 好，在繼續之前，先讓我觀想你的氣場，看看哪種風格最能讓你快樂……

records.source: Yes... I see...
records.translation: 對……我看見了……

records.source: Oops, sorry if that tickles.
records.translation: 哎呀，如果覺得癢，抱歉喔。

records.source: Yikes, sorry if that hurt!
records.translation: 糟糕，要是弄痛你了，對不起！

records.source: Whoa, that's way too much hair gel...
records.translation: 哇，髮膠用得太多了……

records.source: No... this won't do...
records.translation: 不……這樣不行……

records.source: Here, catch!
records.translation: 來，接住！

records.source: Oh look, a cauliflower fritter...
records.translation: 噢，瞧，是花椰菜煎餅……

records.source: Let's trim this a little here...
records.translation: 這裡稍微修剪一下……

records.source: Here, let me use my finger to smudge this a bit...
records.translation: 來，讓我用手指把這裡稍微暈開……

records.source: Okay, get ready, this might be a tight fit...
records.translation: 好，準備一下，這可能會有點緊……

records.source: Okay, I've got it!$h#$b#I'm coming in, so don't be alarmed!
records.translation: 好，我知道了！$h#$b#我要進來了，別嚇到！

records.source: There!
records.translation: 好了！

records.source: Yes! I can feel it, your inner self and outer self are now in perfect alignment!$h#$b#I can't wait for you to see the new 'you'!$h
records.translation: 沒錯！我感覺得到，你的內在與外在現在完美契合！$h#$b#真想趕快讓你看看全新的「自己」！$h

records.source: So? What do you think?#$b#I've put your old clothes in your backpack in case you change your mind!$h
records.translation: 如何？你覺得怎麼樣？#$b#我把舊衣服放進你的背包了，以防你改變主意！$h

records.source: Oops! That's my cue!
records.translation: 哎呀！輪到我登場了！

records.source: Knock, knock, honey! I'm coming in!
records.translation: 叩叩，甜心！我要進來了！

records.source: Let's see here...
records.translation: 讓我看看……

records.source: Okay!
records.translation: 好了！

records.source: That was fun!$h#$b#I hope you're as happy with your new look as I am!$h
records.translation: 真好玩！$h#$b#希望你和我一樣喜歡自己的新造型！$h

records.source: You're looking radiant!#$b#I've put your old clothes in your backpack in case you have a change of heart.$h
records.translation: 你看起來光彩照人！#$b#我把舊衣服放進你的背包了，以防你改變心意。$h

records.source: Hey, I grabbed some random stuff out of my closet. Want any of it?
records.translation: 嘿，我從衣櫥隨手拿了些東西出來。想要哪一件嗎？

records.source: See anything you like?
records.translation: 有看到喜歡的東西嗎？
